fog.environmental_note: The first `run` attempt into /tmp/x3-run67-fog stalled: the fixture wrote all 52 images by 21:58:29 and then sat at 0 % CPU until the runner's hardcoded 540 s timeout fired; the orphaned wine process was killed. The retry into a fresh output directory finished the same work in 50.8 s + 31.8 s, so the stall was environmental, not fixture cost. Because run() refuses a directory that already holds a run, the retry used a scratch copy of the runner (outside the repository) with the shader-step timeout raised to 2400 s; no other line differs and the repository runner is unmodified. /tmp/x3-run67-fog holds the abandoned first attempt.
